title: Second Eyes event log line, format v1
description: One line of a session log (JSON Lines). The top level checks every line; each entry in $defs is the data schema of the event type with that name, and analysis/eventlog.py applies it to lines whose ev matches. Explained in docs/logging.md.

seq.description: Line counter from 0 within one session file.

mono_us.description: Device monotonic clock in integer microseconds; never jumps.

utc_us.description: Wall clock as Unix time in integer microseconds; can jump when the clock is corrected.

ev.description: Event type in lower case, prefixed by its component, e.g. asr.text.

data.description: The event's own fields; a field with a unit carries it in its name, e.g. latency_ms.

app_version.description: Version of the app that wrote the log.

os_build.description: Headset ro.build.fingerprint, or null on a device without one.

where.description: Component or function where it happened.
